headline: Dominican Republic Allocates RD$5.78 Billion for Amber Highway Project
summary: President Luis Abinader announced the release of an initial RD$5.78 billion allocation to break ground on the Amber Highway infrastructure project within 15 days.
why: Public infrastructure development is a major driver of economic growth and construction sector demand in the Dominican Republic.

impacts.name: Dominican Republic
impacts.why: Capital expenditure on major transport links stimulates regional commerce and domestic construction activity.
